name: search
description: Search the catalog's registers, variables, classifications and codes in one ranked list. `q` is free text; `type` keeps one kind of hit; `register` (a FQID or a bare name) and `period` (2019, 2015..2019, LA2019, 2019-03) filter; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

name: show
description: The summary of any ref, by `kind`: a provider, register, variable, classification, `class` (every classification) or a group (`group/<provider>/<register>/<key>`, `group/class/<key>`); no ref is the catalog root. A register lists its variables, groups and variants; a classification its owning variables. `ref` is a FQID or a bare name; a retired FQID answers for its successor, under the successor's `fqid`.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

Classification.description: A classification edition. Its codes are `values`, its edition chain `graph`.

dimensions.description: The classification groups it belongs to.

oneOf.description: The succession family it belongs to.

variables.description:
The variables in scope with a state coded by it (today's `get classification
--variables`), unpaged.

ClassificationRoot.description:
Every current classification, with the classification groups and families.
Editions a family stands for are reached through it.

ConceptGroup.description: A register's concept group: its members in scope.

Coverage.description:
The span a variable or column is delivered over: its earliest start and latest
finite end (null when unknown, or when `open_ended`), and the states (held
periods in holdings) behind it.

Delivery.description:
One `(variant, delivery column)` a variable is delivered under, with its disjoint
windows by start and their span. `column` is null for a state SCB named no
column for.

Derivation.description: A non-temporal derivation link between classifications.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

Family.description: A one-dimensional classification succession family (ICD, LKF, SNI, SSYK).

FamilyEdition.description: An edition of a succession family.

effective_year.description: The year of the edge by which the edition is superseded on the chain.

is_current.description: Started and without an active successor at the policy year.

is_self.description: The edition the family's chain was read from.

Group.description: A group as listed by its register, classification root or member classification.

Member.description: A group member; two members of one variable differ by `delivery_column`.

oneOf.description:
Present on a group's own page only: the member's coverage, its column's
for a representation member (empty when no state delivers the column).

PanelKey.description: A panel key: a variable slug (or `period`), or several (a composite key).

Provider.description: A provider and its registers in scope.

Register.description: A register: its variables, concept groups and variants in scope.

RegisterCoverage.description: A register's span: its variables and the earliest and latest of their states.

Root.description: The catalog root: the providers in scope and the classification root.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

Tag.description: A tag membership: the tag and this member's rank, star and note.

Variable.description:
A variable's shared metadata. Its states, lineage and succession chain are the
`states`, `lineage` and `graph` operations.

group.description: The ref of the concept group the variable belongs to.

same_as.description: The FQIDs of the variables curated as the same variable.

oneOf.description: Null in holdings for a variable with no held delivery.

deliveries.description: Every `(variant, column)` the variable is delivered under in scope.

Variant.description: A register variant (the `variant` filter of `states`), with its versions' prose.

variant_family.description: The key of the variant's succession family: its first head.

name: states
description: A variable's states: each representation it was delivered in, with its variant, bounds, column, coding and the ids of the data warnings that apply to it. Without `period`, the whole history; with `period`, the dated states overlapping it, a state's alias windows standing in for it where they overlap. `variant` and `value_set_version` (`_none` for the empty label) narrow the list. In holdings scope, only what is held, clipped to the held periods. `ref` is a variable FQID or a bare name.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

Conformance.description:
The delivered domain against its declared classification; the mismatching codes
are `values`' `nonstandard` and `sentinels` partitions.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

State.description:
A state: today's `VariableState` under the catalog page's light hydration (its
codes are the `values` facet).

coding_window_from.description: The coding window's start, for a column coded on its own.

period_token.description:
The coarsest period token of the bounds; `_default` when year-independent,
null when open-ended.

value_set.description: Always null: a state's codes are the `values` facet.

warning_ids.description: The data warnings that apply to this representation at its bounds.

StateClassification.description: A classification linked to a representation, with its stored conformance verdict.

ValueSetSummary.description:
`value_set_summary`: a value set's code count and, when its codes are a dense
integer run, its span.

name: docs
description:
`operation` names one of these operations; the other arguments are its parameters (`?` marks an optional one).
- `docs_get` (identifier, scope?): One documentation entry by variable name or filename (with or without `.md`): its register, tags and source, a 500-character `excerpt` and the full markdown `body`.
- `docs_related` (ref, scope?): A register's related documents (rehosted PDFs): title, source, license, and the `sha256` and `byte_size` of the bytes `/api/docs/file/{ref}/{filename}` serves. `ref` is a register FQID or a bare name.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

DocDetail.description: A documentation entry: its metadata, a preview and the full markdown.

excerpt.description: The plain text's first 500 characters, for the SPA.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

RelatedDocument.description: A related document's metadata; the download route serves its bytes.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

name: schema
description:
`operation` names one of these operations; the other arguments are its parameters (`?` marks an optional one).
- `schema` (ref, period?, variant?, scope?, limit?, cursor?): The delivered columns of a register, or of one variable (a FQID or a bare name): one row per register variant, window and column, with its type, width and concept group. `period` (2019, 2015..2019) keeps rows overlapping its years; `variant` keeps one variant (a slug); pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.
- `diff` (ref, from, to, variant?, scope?): A register's columns between two periods, per variant: the variables added at `to`, removed since `from`, and changed in type, width or column (a variable compares by its first column in each period). Variants without changes are left out.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

Diff.description: `diff`'s result: the variants whose columns differ between `from` and `to`.

DiffColumn.description: A variable's column in one period: its first representation there.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

SchemaColumn.description:
One delivered column of a register variant over one window: the CLI's `get schema`
column row with its variant and window. `column` is null for a state SCB named no
column for; `valid_from` and `valid_to` are null when year-independent.

group.description: The variable's concept group, as a group ref.

var_id.description: SCB's numeric variable id; null for other providers.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

VariantDiff.description: A variant's columns added at `to`, removed since `from` and changed, by `fqid`.

name: graph
description:
`operation` names one of these operations; the other arguments are its parameters (`?` marks an optional one).
- `graph` (ref, scope?): The succession graph of a variable, a classification or a group (`group/<provider>/<register>/<key>`, `group/class/<key>`): variable nodes with their states folded into representation runs, classification edition nodes, and directed succession edges. A variable draws its concept group's members, a classification its classification groups; `focus_id` is the requested node. No nodes means nothing to draw.
- `lineage` (ref, scope?): A variable's lineage: the source states feeding each of its states (`edges`), the build's lineage `warnings`, and, for every variable in scope with its name, its register's provenance role (`registers`).

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

ClassificationNode.description: A classification edition, a point in time.

group_key.description: `class/<key>` of the classification group or family it is drawn in.

Edge.description:
A directed succession edge, predecessor to successor. A representation edge
names its columns and, when scoped, its variant.

Error.description: The error document `{code, class, message, remediation, fields}` (section 7).

Graph.description: The graph; no nodes means there is nothing to draw.

focus_id.description: The node of the requested variable or classification; none for a group.

GraphState.description: One emitted state; states sharing `representation_run_id` form one cell.

representation_run_id.description:
Increments at a change of variant, period scope, or (between states) value
set, version label, classifications or delivery column.

registers.description:
Each variable in scope with the variable's name (compared case-insensitively
in ASCII), across registers: whether its register is the variable's source.

LineageEdge.description:
A state of the variable fed by a state of a source variable over the two
states' intersection.

LineageWarning.description:
A build-time warning on one of the variable's states: `no_source_state` or
`ambiguous_source_variant`.

Provenance.description: A variable's provenance in its register.

role.description:
`source` when the register is its own source, `consumer` when it names
another, `unknown` without a source text.

source_register.description: The register the source text was resolved to.

year_range.description:
The first and last year its states span (an open end counts its start
year); empty without a dated state.

Scope.description: The read scope (section 7); every read takes it.

VariableNode.description:
A variable with its state history. A succession edition that is not live in
scope is a bare node: no states, group or metadata.

facets.description: Its facets in its concept group (the first member that is this variable).
